name: THINK+mixer Huber plus pairwise ranking, finite follow-up
architecture: Identical THINK+mixer, including initialization and parameter count; only training objective changes.
objective: 2*Huber(delta=1pp) plus lambda*pairwise logistic; unique valid same-date pairs; ignore target gaps below 0.1pp; sign labels; temperature=1pp; average within date then over dates with pairs.
training: Same data, chronological splits, label purges, feature scalers, groups, 30 maximum epochs, patience=6, validation-MSE checkpoint selection, batch=8, AdamW lr=.001 decay=.001, clip gradient=1.
primary_comparison: Fixed equal-weight K10; alpha including zero selected per test year using current-and-prior validation candidate scores, median minus .25 std. Three seed rank ensemble; no seed picking.
secondary_comparison: Each model's validation-selected portfolio, plus causal alpha selection including zero from current-and-prior validation-policy scores. All fixed lambda results and equal K5/10/20 sensitivities shown.
controls: all previous five-session models and simple benchmarks in comparison charts
costs: Unchanged per-side 2bp commission +5bp slippage +3bp sqrt(participation/1%); initial NAV $1m; 1% lagged ADV trade cap; signal-time ADV >=$1m; next-close execution; annual account reset.
uncertainty: 1000 paired circular 20-session blocks, separately by annual fold; 95% percentile Sharpe and delta intervals. Include paired gains vs Huber and ETFs; no multiple-comparison correction or retraining inside bootstrap.
robustness: Report all years/seeds, K5/10/20, full-universe IC/RankIC/ICIR/RankICIR/NDCG, turnover, win rate, gross/net performance and cost stress.
stop_rule: Complete this finite grid once. Do not add variants or change alpha, early stopping, K or portfolio rules after viewing test metrics.
limitations: 2022-2025 already examined and motivated this follow-up; exploratory reused-test evidence. Historical survivor cohorts, missing delisted prices, revised vendor data and annual-fold gaps remain. Fresh confirmation data needed before claiming improvement.
